countingMethod: Run `npx tsc -b` and count output lines matching the regex /error TS/ (each such line is one TypeScript compiler diagnostic). Example: npx tsc -b 2>&1 | grep -c 'error TS'
notes: Legacy TypeScript debt (down from ~3,435). The gate FAILS the Netlify build only when the measured error count EXCEEDS this baseline (regression). At-or-below baseline keeps the documented legacy debt non-blocking. To update after a burn-down, re-run the counting method above and edit baselineErrors; to prove the detector, run with NETLIFY_GATE_TSC_BASELINE=<lower number> (env override, no file edit).
